text: On a quiet desk, in a quiet room, sat a book that nobody had opened in a very long time.
zh: 安静的书桌上，安静的房间里，有一本很久很久没人翻开的书。

text: Until one evening… somebody did.
zh: 直到某个傍晚……有人翻开了它。

text: Inside, in a land made entirely of paper, lived a little sprite named Pip.
zh: 书里有一片全用纸做成的土地，住着一个叫皮普的小精灵。

text: Good morning, Papervale!
zh: 早上好，纸片谷！

text: Pip loved Papervale. The cardboard hills. The paper sun on its wooden stick. And the river, that went swish… swish… swish.
zh: 皮普喜欢纸片谷：硬纸板的山丘，插在木棍上的纸太阳，还有那条哗啦、哗啦、哗啦的小河。

text: But every evening, when the sun went down, another light came on. A big, warm light, from somewhere beyond the edge of the page.
zh: 可每到傍晚太阳落下，另一盏灯就会亮起——又大又暖的光，从书页边缘之外的某个地方照进来。

text: I'm going to find out where it comes from!
zh: 我要去找到它从哪里来！

text: So Pip set off, through the Whispering Woods,
zh: 于是皮普出发了，穿过窃窃私语森林，

text: Hmph! Nobody gets past ME!
zh: 哼！谁也别想过去！

text: where Pip learned that a grumpy crumple… just needs someone to smooth things out.
zh: 在那里皮普明白了：皱巴巴的坏脾气，只是需要有人帮它抚平。

text: Wheee! I'm Fold! Let's go!
zh: 呜呼！我叫折折！出发吧！

text: Together, they sailed the Swish-Swash Sea,
zh: 他们一起驶过哗啦哗啦海，

text: on through the night, beneath the stars on their strings,
zh: 穿过夜色，在一颗颗挂在线上的星星下，

text: until they reached the very last page. Nothing else was drawn there. Just two words. The End.
zh: 直到最后一页。那里什么都还没画，只有两个词：The End（全书完）。

text: Pip had never been off the page before. It was a little bit scary.
zh: 皮普从没离开过书页。有一点点害怕。

text: Here goes!
zh: 冲啦！

text: But the best adventures always are.
zh: 可最好的冒险，总是这样。

text: And that is how Pip found out where the big, warm light came from.
zh: 就这样，皮普找到了那束又大又暖的光从哪里来。

text: A reading lamp… and someone, reading along.
zh: 一盏台灯……还有一个正在读故事的人。

text: Hello, big world!
zh: 你好，大大的世界！

text: The end? Or maybe… just the beginning.
zh: 结束了？也许……才刚刚开始。
